## Activity

During October 2018, North City Eye Clinic completed 500 photographic captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of routine clinic operations. The reported volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading workload. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Image quality

Image quality was reviewed against the captures completed during the reporting period. There were 4 ungradable image sets, representing an ungradable rate of 0.8 per cent. This proportion indicates that the great majority of captures were suitable for grading. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, with any recurring issues addressed through normal operational processes.

## Grading

A total of 82 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This measure should be considered alongside the activity level and the number of ungradable images when reviewing the service’s performance for October 2018. Overall, the report records the month’s activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for North City Eye Clinic.
